ingredients.title: Cookie dough layer
items: 1 cup (6 oz) mini semisweet chocolate chips

instructions.title: Brownies
items: In a microwave, melt chocolate chips; stir until smooth. Cool slightly.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Combine flour and baking soda; gradually add to batter.
Spread into a greased 13x9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350°F for 16-22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.

instructions.title: Cookie dough layer
items: In a small bowl, cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in milk and vanilla. Gradually add flour. Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop by tablespoonfuls over cooled brownies; carefully spread over top.
Cut into squares. Store in the refrigerator.

notes.title: Open questions
items: The brownie salt is listed but not in the steps. Is it combined with the flour and baking soda?
